subject: An adult Tamil woman wearing a deep maroon Kanchipuram silk sari with a gold zari border, crouching to draw a white rice-flour kolam by hand

setting.place: A lived-in Chettinad house courtyard in Karaikudi, Tamil Nadu
setting.architecture: An open central courtyard with lime-plastered walls, wooden pillars, terracotta roof tiles and patterned Athangudi floor tiles around a plain kolam-drawing area
setting.time_of_day: Late afternoon golden hour shortly before sunset

lighting: Natural sunlight entering the open courtyard, with direction and warmth appropriate to the specified time of day

camera.shot: Wide shot showing the woman and the courtyard

style: Photorealistic documentary photography with natural skin texture, believable proportions and a quiet everyday atmosphere
